item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena pours 200 mL of water from a bottle into a round bowl in her kitchen. The water spreads to take the shape of the bowl, but its volume stays 200 mL. Which statement correctly explains this?

options.A: The water particles break down into smaller particles when poured.
options.B: The water particles can move and change positions while attractions keep them close together.
options.C: The water particles are tightly fixed in one position and cannot move at all.
options.D: The water particles are far apart and move freely in all directions like a gas.
